description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #2: dsncreatortest holds only identity-wide ego.dsn.admin (no ego.root -- see perm-40) and creates a table in the restricted DSN it owns. Before the fix, TableCreate's own in-handler check called Authorized() with a table name that was never DSN-qualified, so the DSN lookup inside Authorized() always failed and the create was denied for every caller except literal root -- regardless of how much DSN-level standing they actually had. This is exactly the caller docs/SERVER.md says should succeed: 'whoever creates a table is automatically granted all five actions on it' presupposes someone who isn't root can create one in the first place.
